project_name: Digital Doppelgänger: Multi-Agent Cyber-Physical PII Defense
description: Autonomous multi-agent system defending personal identity against cyber-physical re-identification across federated enterprise and consumer data silos.

zetaris.role: Virtual Data Warehouse (VDW) & Data Virtualization Layer
zetaris.architecture: Federates disparate data silos (fitness tracking, food delivery, calendar schedules, social media, pharmacy records, employee directory) without data duplication.

interfaces.auth: Bearer API Token (ZETARIS_API_KEY) with X-Org-ID and X-Request-ID headers

query_features: Cross-silo federated SQL joins (e.g., Strava GPS clusters joined with Food Delivery dropoffs)
Read-only tool guard enforcing AST-level SQL validation
Deterministic local analytical fallback engine via DuckDB

features: Specialized reasoning models for adversarial reconstruction
Strict 30s timeout with exponential backoff retry
Execution step timing and latency budgets

agent_architecture.name: PlannerAgent
agent_architecture.role: Dynamically selects required data silos and generates targeted evidence queries.

agent_architecture.name: ExtractorAgent
agent_architecture.role: Extracts atomic facts deterministically from raw data silos.

agent_architecture.name: LinkerAgent
agent_architecture.role: Correlates facts across silos into composite entities (Places, Routines, SAME_AS).

agent_architecture.name: PersonaAgent
agent_architecture.role: Constructs the full digital persona world model.

agent_architecture.name: RedTeamAgent
agent_architecture.role: Adversarially attempts PII reconstruction and impersonation attacks.

agent_architecture.name: VerifierAgent
agent_architecture.role: Scores attack plausibility against grounded evidence.

agent_architecture.name: ReporterAgent
agent_architecture.role: Synthesizes final risk assessment, mitigation cost model, and remediation plan.
